log.msg: ITEM 1 PROVEN - THE NEST FIELD KEEPS WHAT YOU TYPED. On /imagine/paging/ I opened More, typed dashboard into the nest field and NEVER pressed Enter. The file box gained the line while I typed: mode.nest dashboard, with the address bar still bare. I typed a name and pressed Make this a page, and public/imagine/paging/made/fix-seven-no-enter/page.json read nest dashboard. The field now also READS BACK: arriving at ?nest=dashboard the field holds dashboard and the chip is on. Three things do it - the field is held on the stage and read live by node_for(), by both exports and by save(); a change (blur) commits it without drawer.refresh(), which would delete the button mid-click; and a line under the field says what the value means while you type, or that an address starts with a slash.

ITEM 2 PROVEN ON BOTH EDITORS. On /imagine/paging/make/notes/ the drawer now prints the REAL file (children today, later) and code_for_node's page.js with children: 'today later' and a pages: block - it printed seven words with neither before. There is no second Save there: the acts are Copy this link, Put it inside, Copy the file, Copy the code, Delete Notes. On /imagine/paging/build/ the drawer has NO file box and NO code box (0 code boxes measured), one act (Put it inside), and a line pointing at the page's own two boxes; the bar over Build now shows only More, because the Code button would have opened a second copy of a box already on screen. The link box on an inner stage says there is no link to this exact page instead of handing out an address that opens on different words.

ITEM 3 PROVEN - BUILD KEEPS ITS NEST. On /imagine/paging/build/ I typed dashboard in the drawer's nest field and pressed Put it inside: the file pane gained mode.nest dashboard. I then pressed Add a tab, twice: the dashboard is still running in the box (paging-bg-tint paging-type-compact paging-arr-bar-top paging-nav-rail), the file still says nest dashboard AND now carries the new child, and the printed page.js carries nest: "dashboard" under its own comment. Two lines: build/stage.js passes nest: mode_of(node).nest, build/page.js sets keep_nest with screen:false. code_for_node prints nest now too.

ITEM 4 PROVEN END TO END. Delete exists in two places now. Make's row: the x turns the row into the question - Delete Notes and the 2 pages under it? - with Delete it and Cancel (it had a one-press x with no label, which is why a newcomer walked the whole realm and reported no delete existed). And the made page's OWN drawer: Delete <title>, then Yes - delete <title> and its file. Measured: I deleted the page item 1 made. The drawer's second press navigated to /imagine/paging/make/, the row is gone (Notes, Today, Later, Ideas, Archive), made/page.json children read notes, ideas, archive, made/fix-seven-no-enter/page.json answers 404, and the url answers 404 - nothing matches /imagine/paging/make/fix-seven-no-enter/. made/ is byte-identical to baseline by md5.

ITEM 5 PROVEN, AND THE BRIEF'S FIX WAS HALF OF IT. max-height plus overflow stopped the column hanging past the bottom of the window (1382 in a 1400 window, was 1617), but it did NOT stop it covering the file pane: in Chromium a position:sticky GRID ITEM is held inside the whole grid CONTAINER, not inside its own grid area, so a card whose rows were controls|stage, then file, then code kept the stage pinned over both boxes all the way down. The file and the code are now SIBLINGS under the card rather than rows of it. Measured at 3440 after scrolling: 4 of 4 probe points along the file pane's own first line hit build-json-text; 3 of 4 hit the stage before.

ITEM 6 - THE SMALL LINKS. templates/navigation's row read imagine/paging/words.js and went to doc/mechanisms.md; the label names a source file, so the href now IS that file (/imagine/paging/words.js) - verified live. Three prose links to raw markdown now point at the rendered page instead: /templates/theming/ The proposal -> /imagine/paging/doc/templates/, and doc/persistence.md from /make/ and /build/ -> /imagine/paging/doc/persistence/. Zero visible raw .md links remain on those four pages, and all three rendered doc pages answer with no md-error.

WHOLE-REALM CRAWL, first pass: 110 pages x 400/1280/1920/3440 = 440 cold loads, following every in-realm link. FOUR loads with a console error and all four are the same known one - the readme/page.js declared-child probe 404, once per width. Zero sideways document scroll at any width. (The audit counted 104; my crawler also follows the .md and .js file links, which it does NOT give a trailing slash to - the false-404 trap the seventh audit found in its own instrument.)

ONE THING THE BRIEF'S FIX WOULD NOT HAVE FIXED, and I only found it by measuring after. max-height plus overflow on .build-centre is right and necessary, but on its own it left 3 of 4 probe points along the file pane still hitting the stage. Chromium holds a position:sticky GRID ITEM inside the whole grid CONTAINER, not inside its own grid area, so while the file and the code were rows of the same grid the stage stayed pinned over them however short it was. Moving those two boxes out of the card - siblings under it, in a flex column - is what actually fixed it, and it is recorded in doc/decisions.md so the next person does not re-add the rows.

assign.outcome:
**All six landed.** A nest you type cannot be lost any more, the drawer prints the page you are actually standing on, Build keeps the page you put inside it, a page you make can be unmade, and the builder's middle column stops painting over its own file.

![On a page you made, the drawer now shows the file it IS — children today and later — the `page.js` for those real children, and a Delete](shots/made-drawer-1280.png)

**1 — Type a nest, press Save, and the file has it.** Enter was the only thing that committed the nest field, so a green tick could name a file that did not contain what you typed. The field is now **read on the press** — by the file box, by both exports and by Save — and it commits on the way out of the field too. **Proved:** typed `dashboard`, never pressed Enter, pressed *Make this a page*, and the file on disk read `"nest": "dashboard"`. The file box gains that line **as you type**, and a sentence under the field says what the value means — or that an address starts with `/`. It **reads back**: arrive at `?nest=dashboard` and the field holds `dashboard`.

**2 — The drawer asks the page what it is.** Its boxes were written for a page that is only seven words, and neither editor is one. A page now answers two questions — `node_now()` (the node I am) and `prints_own_file`. On **[a page you made](/imagine/paging/make/notes/)** the drawer prints the real `page.json` (children `today`, `later`) and a `page.js` with `children: "today later"` and its `pages:` block; it printed neither before. On **[Build](/imagine/paging/build/)** it prints nothing of its own and points at the page's own boxes — **one file, one code box, one Save** — and the bar's *Code* button is gone, because it opened a second copy of a box already on screen. A stage that cannot read an address no longer hands you one.

![The drawer over Build: the words and the nest, then one line pointing at the page's own file, code and Save](shots/build-drawer-1280.png)

**3 — Build keeps its nest.** Two lines, both twins of `make/page.js`. **Proved:** put a dashboard in Build's box, pressed **Add a tab** twice — the dashboard is still running, the file still says `nest`, and the printed `page.js` carries it.

**4 — A page you make can be unmade.** Two doors, both through Make's one write seam. Make's `×` turns the row into the question — *Delete Row delete test?* — with **Delete it** and **Cancel**; and the page's own drawer has *Delete ‹title›* → *Yes — delete it and its file*. **Proved end to end:** made a page, deleted it from its own drawer, landed back on **[Make](/imagine/paging/make/)** with the row gone, `made/page.json` no longer naming it, its file 404, and its url answering *404 — nothing matches*.

**5 — The builder's middle column.** `max-height` and its own overflow were half of it. The other half: **Chromium holds a sticky grid item inside the whole grid container, not its own row**, so while the file and the code were rows of the card the stage stayed pinned over them however short it was. They are siblings under the card now. **Measured at 3440:** 4 of 4 probe points along the file pane's first line hit the file pane; 3 of 4 hit the stage before.

**6 — The small links.** The row that read `imagine/paging/words.js` now goes to `words.js`, and **every** prose link to raw markdown in the realm now opens the rendered page — the three the audit named, plus five more on the readme itself. Zero raw `.md` links remain.

**Checked:** **110 pages × 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440 = 440 cold loads**, following every in-realm link. **Four loads with a console error, and all four are the same known one** — the `readme/page.js` declared-child probe 404, once per width. Zero sideways scroll at any width. `made/` is byte-identical to its baseline by md5: every test page was deleted by the feature it was testing. Private server 8093, killed by pid.

**Left:** the two other things a newcomer still cannot do — add a child from the page's own bar, and type prose into the box outside Build. Neither is on either seventh list.
